name: Thi Nai bridge
kicker: The white span across the lagoon
summary: Photograph the white span on the road toward the peninsula. The bridge is free. The photograph is the span by day. The portal describes the lamps after dark.
timeNeeded: 30 minutes on the portal. It is a road.
getThere: The lagoon is 8 km northeast. Minutes from the beach are check on arrival.
heroCaption: The span by day, with mangrove and water

notice.title: Two lengths, and a daytime frame
notice.body: The bridge page calls it the longest sea bridge and does not print the metres. The lagoon page prints 2,477.3 m and 54 spans, on a road of more than 7 km. The photograph is the span by day.

gettingThere: The bridge page places Cầu Thị Nại in Phường Quy Nhơn and calls it the longest sea bridge without printing the metres. The lagoon page prints 2,477.3 m and 54 spans, on a road of more than 7 km that also has five shorter bridges. The lagoon is 8 km northeast. Minutes from the beach are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From the city beach
legs.body: By road toward the peninsula. The portal does not print the minutes. Check on arrival.

hours: The portal prints 7:00–18:00. The same page describes the bridge after dark, so that line is not a gate that closes the road.
closed: No weekly closing day is printed.
